attorneys: Edward Bennett Williams (appointed by this Court, 368 U. S. 973) argued the cause and filed a supplemental brief for petitioners. Sol A. Abrams also filed a brief for petitioners. Solicitor General Cox argued the cause for the United States. With him on the briefs were Assistant Attorney General Miller, Beatrice Rosenberg, J. F. Bishop and Julia P. Cooper.
